name: worker
description: This starter gives you a **single Worker** that can: - Link your Google Workspace account (OAuth) - Read inbox + send emails via Gmail API - List Calendar events (and provides hooks to sync with Notion) - Store tokens & state in Cloudflare KV - Expose simple REST endpoints and a mini HTML dashboard - Run scheduled jobs (cron) to do syncs

scripts.test: npm run check-safeNext && npm run check-mailSend && npm run check-sanitize && npm run check-elli && npm run test:proxy-signature
